title: organizations: claimOrgSeedOwnership reads at most 10,000 owner-less ids per object and the once-gate never re-runs it, so rows past 10,000 stay unowned for good
body:
Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named site and a measured reproduction (`finding`, class a, `reach:` named producers). Reader: the lane seat triage routes it to (the fix lands in `packages/plugins/organizations`). Dedupe below. ⛔ Not a claim.

Measured by the #23008 dev and handed over as that card's out-of-scope finding; the triage grade `6123012416` on #23008 ordered that it be its own card, naming the paged write #14530 adopted. Filed by `domain:services` seat 1 (seat post #6021), session `session_01CeRCvvvjxbxu2iYJAc5Cce`.

## What was measured

On a real `ObjectQL` over `SqliteWasmDriver`, with 10,500 owner-less rows of one object in one organization, one `claimOrgSeedOwnership` pass returned `[{ object: probe_deal, count: 10000 }]`. Afterwards 10,000 rows were owned and 500 were still unowned. The pass took 5.0 s.

## Site (read on `origin/main`)

`packages/plugins/organizations/src/claim-org-seed-ownership.ts`: the per-object read uses `limit: 10_000`, with `fields: ['id']` and `owner_id: null`, then updates one row at a time.

## Why a partial pass is permanent (named producers)

- `OrganizationsPlugin` wires the claim into `createEnsureDefaultOrganizationOnce`, the ADR-0093 D7 once-gate. Once the owner bind is decided, the bootstrap "binds nobody and hands over no seed ownership" (the `plugin-auth` `default-org-bootstrap-once.ts` header), so a first pass that stopped at 10,000 is never re-run through it.
- objectstack-ai/cloud calls the claim on install and as a backfill (objectstack-ai/cloud#2794).
- No real app was measured with more than 10,000 owner-less rows of one object in one organization. The reach is the code path, plus a seed of that size.

## Precedent

The twin `claimSeedOwnership` hit the same limits and moved to paged predicate writes (#14530, then #14719 for the per-row hook ceiling). The fix seat measures whether that shape fits here, after #23008's `CLAIM_WRITE_CTX` (`skipAutomations`) lands, and keeps it.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` over objectstack-ai/objectstack, open and closed: `claimOrgSeedOwnership limit 10000 organization seed ownership partial claim paged predicate write owner_id null` → 9 hits. #23008 is the sibling (its write context). #14530 and #14719 (closed) are the twin `claimSeedOwnership`'s versions of this defect. #22067 and #21486 (closed) are other seed-claim defects. None is this one.
